C1062583.source: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter" (Confluence 947650561, version 11, 5 Nov 2026), Story 4 error handling: "If a bucket's later lines stop loading while the user scrolls, the lines already shown stay and the bucket shows "Not every line loaded. Collapse and expand this bucket to try again." under them."
observed: Set up: A/P Aging Detail as of 11/11/2026; "1-30 days past due" has 496 lines; expanded, it shows its first 100.
Step 3: switch the network off and scroll down to the end of the bucket.
You see: the first 100 lines stay, nothing more loads, and no message appears under them (watched 30 seconds, three tries).
The test says the bucket shows "Not every line loaded. Collapse and expand this bucket to try again." under the lines already shown.
For the developer: when the next lines fail while the computer is online, the message does appear - with the network off the bucket never asks for them, so nothing tells the user.
